Classic GT coupe, rally hatch and urban taxi by tevy, CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

gt-coupe.glb: Classic Coupe, version 1, LOD1
https://tevy.dev/models/classic-coupe/v1/lod1.glb

rally-car.glb: Rally Car, version 1, LOD1
https://tevy.dev/models/rally-car/v1/lod1.glb

city-taxi.glb: City Taxi, version 1, LOD1
https://tevy.dev/models/city-taxi/v1/lod1.glb

Meshes decoded from Meshopt and textures transcoded for baseline glTF loading.
Window transmission changed to tinted alpha blending. Wheel and steering pivots
retain the original articulated hierarchy. Paint and tail light material names
were normalized for game control.
City taxi body repainted in golden yellow.

family-suv.glb is adapted from Mid-Size SUV by tevy, v1 LOD1, CC0 1.0.
https://tevy.dev/models/suv/v1/lod1.glb
The three-row version has a longer wheelbase and cargo area, a raised roof,
seven seats, steering pivots, and embedded JPEG maps.

Additional vehicles by tevy, CC0 1.0 Universal:
electric-gt.glb: Electric Grand Tourer, v1 LOD1
https://tevy.dev/models/electric-gt/v1/lod1.glb
family-minivan.glb: Family Minivan, v1 LOD1
https://tevy.dev/models/family-minivan/v1/lod1.glb
muscle-car.glb: Muscle Car, v1 LOD0
https://tevy.dev/models/muscle-car/v1/lod0.glb
Geometry decoded, textures embedded as JPEG and glass adapted for mobile.
Wheel and steering pivots and material names adapted for the game.

city-sedan.glb and classic-sedan.glb: original ViVu3D unbranded sedan
geometry and materials. Rebuild with tools/build_player_sedans.py.

compact-mpv.glb: adapted from Family Minivan v1 LOD1 by tevy, CC0 1.0.
https://tevy.dev/models/family-minivan/v1/lod1.glb
Reshaped body and glazing, hinged rear door styling, 2+3+2 seating,
split-level lights, bumper and grille by ViVu3D.

touring-mpv.glb: adapted from the project's seven-seat version of Mid-Size
SUV v1 LOD1 by tevy, CC0 1.0. https://tevy.dev/models/suv/v1/lod1.glb
The new body has a longer cabin, a lower bonnet, revised roofline and side
panels, and its own lights, grille and bumper trim.

street-motorcycle.glb is adapted from "Street Motorcycle" by vinish.dev.
Source: https://vinish.dev/free-3d-models/motorcycles
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
ViVu3D repainted the tank, fenders and frame, removed the side stand, simplified
geometry and textures, and adapted the wheel pivots, mirrors, lights and dash.

The garage preview images are renders of the corresponding playable models.

mustang-gt3.glb is adapted from "Mustang GT3-77" by toddeppe.
Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/mustang-gt3-77-00d3930b7f384859bef0ec32eacd74fe
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
ViVu3D reduced the geometry and textures, removed unused UV sets, quantized the
meshes, split the tail lights into their own material and rebuilt the wheel
and steering pivots for the game.
